arguments.command:
python -c "
from more_itertools import relative_seek, seekable

# Test with string
it = seekable('abcdef')
print('After creation:')
print('  _consumed:', it._consumed)
print('  _index:', it._index)

next(it), next(it), next(it)
print('After 3 nexts (a, b, c):')
print('  _consumed:', it._consumed)
print('  _index:', it._index)
print('  cache:', list(it._cache))

print('Calling next(it):', next(it))
print('After 4th next (d):')
print('  _consumed:', it._consumed)
print('  _index:', it._index)
print('  cache:', list(it._cache))

relative_seek(it, 1)
print('After relative_seek +1:')
print('  _consumed:', it._consumed)
print('  _index:', it._index)
print('  cache:', list(it._cache))

print('Calling next(it):', next(it))
"
